title: Filed Early
setup: The ride down, after the budget. Fourteen floors. She holds the memo.
conflict: Max needs absolution. Roxy needs acknowledgment. Neither gives.

scriptedLines.txt: Car descends. Fourteen floors of silence scheduled. Two used.
You filed it before I even did it.
That's not confidence in me, chief.
Floor 3. The longest floor in the building.
Ding. She exits without answering. He rides back up to ask again. She has taken the stairs.

clipMoment: The whole ride. The ding lands like a verdict.
